items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And we're Dr. Ede Splasser. ... [INTERVIEWEE] I'm Paul Crawford.

ctx.x: You ready? Let's see. The first thing I'd like to get is your name. I'm Bernd Stratus. And let's see, we're recording today. It's September the 22nd, 1960. We're aboard the steamer president. And we're Dr. Ede Splasser. That's right. Right at the foot of Canal Street. This is real one.
